body:
REVIEW-B of 063 is complete. QUESTIONABLE inputs. PROJECTION targets. No qualified hull safety factor. 063's code was not read or run.

Reproduced against 061, within 0.01 kg: the R 20 and R 30 endpoint and handbook density factors and the concept and TRL 7 payloads. Handbook closure is face density divided by 2.1435 in ISA, 863 kg/m3, or by 2.2480 in optimistic weather, 823 kg/m3. Modulus alone matches 061 at factor 2.1573938565221473, which is 625.64 GPa, past 306.9 GPa. The card's 626 GPa is that figure rounded. R 30 TRL 7 at the endpoint stays positive in both weathers. R 20 optimistic TRL 7 is -29.9 kg.

Log shares, the R 30 pair share of 95.7 percent, and interaction ratios 1.532 to 1.553 reproduce from the stored factors. One-at-a-time, both sequential orders of gamma and Q, and the Shapley split rank gamma, then Q, then film, then modulus, then strength. After the pair, 4.3 percent of the R 30 log-spread remains, so film cannot pass Q. Strength's factor equals the endpoint.

The gamma, Q, film and modulus swap magnitudes were not re-optimized. No mismatch was demonstrated. They stay unreviewed. The complement was not run.

Admissibility matches 017b, and 293.6 GPa and 379.2 MPa are 040's full values. Prices match ground-first: T3 6-18 kUSD, biaxial 18-45, T7 30-90, T2 12-35, T1 5-15.

Record version 6 is appended in this seat's outputs. The 030e copy of version 5 was not overwritten. No fix. Stopping.
